pm_collateral_supplied.meaning: the Vault has supplied collateral under PM for the account before settlement

pm_borrow_liability_present.meaning: the PM borrow-lend state carries a negative quote liability for the account before settlement

precompile_payload_has_borrow_and_supply.meaning: the 0x811 payload contains borrow.basis, borrow.value, supply.basis and supply.value for the token

usdc_moved_into_yieldescrow.meaning: settle() moved real USDC into YieldEscrow

assumptions: The PM account's true net borrow-lend state is negative (borrow liability exceeds supplied collateral) in the reported scenario, so the distributable-surplus gate should block settlement.
settle() is the operation whose completion is checked; distributeYield() is a downstream step not formalized here.
The report describes a potential normal-flow scenario rather than an observed transaction.

unresolved.description: Report gives no numeric values for borrow.value, supply.value, surplus or proposedYield, so the negative-net-state condition is represented only by the qualitative borrow-liability-present Boolean.
Report does not state the exact gate predicate (backing vs liabilities comparison) that settle() evaluates, only that it should block unbacked yield.

limitations: Only the real_usdc_moved_into_yieldescrow impact is formalized; minting of USDM into sUSDM and insurance/foundation routing are separate claim passes.
The relation is stated as absence of the USDC-into-YieldEscrow movement under the PM borrow scenario; the backing arithmetic root cause is not encoded as P.
Whether the scenario was actually executed onchain is not established by the report.
